text:
A dual-axis tourbillon, presented like a luxury watch ad—inside Gemini Canvas.

Five chapters, three view modes, an acoustic oscilloscope, and gold mechanisms against a black background. The video captures an interactive app, with controls for exploring the mechanism.

A useful direction for AI-built product demos: give people something they can inspect and explore.
